name: firecrawl
description: Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond. Building the library for superintelligence. 🔥
readme: The API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale. Firecrawl is the context API for AI agents. 🔥 Open source and available as a hosted service. Industry-leading reliability: Covers 96% of the web, including JS-heavy pages — no proxy headaches, just clean data (see benchmarks) Blazingly fast: P95 latency of 3.4s across millions of pages, built for real-time agents and dynamic apps LLM-ready output: Clean markdown, structured JSON, screenshots, and more — spend fewer tokens, build better AI apps We handle the hard stuff: Rotating proxies, orchestration, rate limits, JS-blocked content, and more — zero configuration Agent ready: Connect Firecrawl to any AI agent or MCP client with…
